jobs.occupation: Systems Engineer Exploration, Space Safety and Space Transportation (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
jobs.description:
Your Tasks

In this role, you will be responsible for the holistic systems engineering of complex space missions, from early concept phases through to verification. You will analyze customer, mission and system requirements and translate them into structured specifications, including the development of functional architectures and identification of required adaptations.

A key part of your work will involve the derivation and management of requirements down to subsystem and equipment level using DOORS, as well as supporting trade-offs and shaping the overall mission and system architecture. You will actively contribute to the design and development of space systems, covering everything from mission analysis to subsystem specifications.

You will coordinate technical activities across subsystems and internal stakeholders, ensuring alignment in case of requirement changes and assessing their impact. In addition, you will act as a key interface to subcontractors (on behalf of the Project Chief Engineer or Project Manager) as well as to external partners, including industry and ESA.

Your responsibilities also include supporting system design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR), verification planning and the monitoring of requirement compliance. You will contribute to defining verification strategies, preparing test specifications and evaluating test results. Furthermore, you will support the implementation of design changes (e.g. RFWs, RFDs, NCRs) and contribute to the preparation of proposals for future exploration missions.
Your Qualifications

You hold a degree (Diploma or Master) in aerospace engineering or a comparable qualification and bring a solid foundation in systems engineering. You have experience in requirements analysis, specification development and the definition of system architectures, ideally complemented by knowledge of interface management.

Practical experience in areas such as exploration, space safety or space transportation is a strong asset. Beyond your technical expertise, you demonstrate strong communication skills and feel comfortable working in international, interdisciplinary teams within structured project environments.

Your strengths include creativity, a solution-oriented mindset and the ability to navigate complex challenges effectively.

You are confident communicating in English; German language skills are an advantage.

The SAP FI/CO Professional will play a key role in supporting the Körber OneFinance transformation program. This role combines hands‑on SAP S/4HANA expertise with strong process knowledge across Finance, Controlling, and integrated logistics and sales processes. The ideal candidate brings practical experience in SAP FI/CO within S/4HANA environments, an excellent understanding of core accounting processes, and the ability to provide expert support throughout the rollout and post-go‑live stabilization.

Acting as a backfill within the project organization, this position ensures operational continuity while contributing to the successful deployment of S/4HANA across the Körber Group.

Your role in our team

S/4HANA Implementation & Support

- You provide hands‑on expertise in SAP FI/CO during the S/4HANA rollout, supporting fit‑gap analyses, testing activities, data validation, and cutover preparation
- You ensure that financial processes in the new system reflect business requirements and adhere to internal and external compliance standards
- You take ownership of post-go‑live support, including resolving incidents, optimizing processes, and stabilizing the financial landscape after deployment

Process Expertise Across Finance & Logistics

- You bring deep knowledge of end‑to‑end accounting processes such as Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, General Ledger, Asset Accounting, and Financial Closing
- You support controlling‑related processes (e.g., cost center accounting, internal orders, basic profitability analysis) and collaborate with CO experts as needed
- You understand key touchpoints between Finance and logistics processes (FI/MM integration for procurement, FI/SD/CO integration for order‑to‑cash) and help ensure seamless E2E process flows

Cross‑Functional Collaboration

- As an interface between Finance, IT, and business stakeholders, you ensure clear communication and alignment during design, testing, and rollout
- You support business users with training, documentation, and day‑to‑day issue resolution
- You collaborate with workstreams to address process dependencies and coordinate integrations across modules (MM, SD, CO)

Operational Backfill & Business Continuity

- You temporarily take over operational FI/CO tasks to free up internal experts for project activities
- You ensure stable daily operations throughout the S/4HANA transformation
- You help identify opportunities for process simplification, automation, or harmonization under the OneFinance/GBS framework

Your profile

- You hold a degree in Business Administration, Finance, Business Informatics, or a comparable field of study
- You bring hands‑on experience in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO, ideally from project or transformational environments
- You have strong expertise in Finance processes (AP, AR, GL, Assets, closing) and good general knowledge of Controlling processes.
- You understand integrated logistics flows, ideally with experience in FI/MM and SD/FI/CO integration
- You are comfortable working in dynamic environments and managing multiple priorities during rollout phases
- With strong communication skills and cultural awareness, you collaborate effectively in international, cross‑functional teams
- You are fluent in English and German
- You bring an analytical, solution‑oriented mindset and enjoy working hands‑on with systems and data
- You are flexible with occasional business travel
- Experience in global or matrix organizations and familiarity with shared services (GBS) is beneficial

Your benefits

- Diverse opportunities to help shape the role and extensive options for training and development
- Flexible working hours and flat hierarchies in an international, modern work environment
- Mobile working within Germany as well as remote work abroad
- A work environment with room for initiative and clear ownership of your own topics and projects
- EGYM Wellpass and supplementary company health insurance to support personal well‑being
- An Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering confidential advice and support for health-related, professional, and personal challenges
- Company pension schemes to provide long‑term security
- Employer subsidy for the Deutschlandticket
- Monthly attractive employee offers through a leading discount portal
- IT leasing through salary conversion enables access to modern devices at attractive conditions - including for private use

Your working environment

As a groupwide shared service organization, Körber Global Business Services GmbH consolidates central functions in the areas of HR, IT, and Finance. We support the companies of the Körber Group with efficient processes and standardized service offerings, thereby making a significant contribution to the success of the international Group.

jobs.description:
Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! One of the most operationally significant roles in the new CREM structure, the Global Head of Facilities Management is responsible for leading and transforming Merck's facilities and workplace management function across a global portfolio of 340+ locations and 4.3 million m² — encompassing offices, standalone labs, warehouses and selected soft services at manufacturing sites across more than 60 countries.
This is a dual-focus role requiring transformational vision and strict operational leadership. You will consolidate our existing FM foundation into a high-performing, data-informed ecosystem designed to minimise operational vulnerability. Through uniform service delivery standards and a consolidated regional IFM vendor model, you will drive process efficiency, strengthen risk controls, and unlock strategic business value across Merck's global footprint.
The scale of the people dimension alone is significant: this role leads a global FM organisation with a substantial team within CREM, with additional headcount transferring from business sectors as the expanded remit is stood up.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- FM Strategy & Vision: Define and own the global FM strategy for CREM — establishing a unified vision, service delivery model and operating standards across all asset classes and geographies, aligned to Merck's broader corporate objectives.
- Transformation Leadership: Lead the FM transformation programme — driving vendor consolidation toward a consolidated regional IFM model, standing up site-level governance, managing the lift-and-shift of FM services from business sectors, and embedding a performance management culture across the function.
- Stakeholder Engagement: Build trusted relationships with business sector leads, site managers and senior Merck stakeholders — positioning FM as a value-creating partner and ensuring the function is responsive to business needs.
- Operational Leadership: Ensure consistent, high-quality FM service delivery and drive operational excellence across the full portfolio by standardising service delivery and optimising facilities performance — maintaining service continuity throughout the transformation and holding Regional Heads accountable for operational performance within their geographies.
- IFM Partner Management: Own Merck's most senior relationships with global and regional IFM providers — acting as the primary Merck counterpart in strategic vendor negotiations, performance reviews and vendor [AB8.1]management at a global level.
- FM Budget Responsibility: Manage the global FM budget, allocating, monitoring, and optimising operational and capital expenditure (OpEx/CapEx) across the portfolio to ensure cost-efficiency, regulatory compliance, and alignment with corporate financial objectives.
- Budget Authority: Hold direct budget authority for FM vendor contracts and operational spend across the full scope — managing significant global FM expenditure, driving cost efficiency and ensuring financial transparency across the function.
- Standards & Compliance: Establish and enforce binding global FM standards — covering vendor protocols, preventative maintenance schedules, H&S compliance, SLAs and performance penalties. Ensure consistent application across all geographies.
- Manufacturing FM: Oversee the delivery of selected soft FM services at manufacturing sites — working in close collaboration with the Quality & Compliance Lead to ensure service delivery meets the specific operational and regulatory requirements of Merck's manufacturing environments.
- Performance Management: Establish and own the FM KPI framework — tracking performance against industry benchmarks (IFMA, RICS), driving continuous improvement and ensuring data-driven decision making is embedded across the function to achieve operational excellence.
- People Management: Lead, develop and inspire a global FM organisation — including four Regional Heads and the Quality & Compliance Lead — through a period of significant organisational change, building a high-performance culture.

QUALIFICATIONS

- 15–20+ years in facilities management leadership, with significant experience managing a large, complex and geographically diverse FM portfolio within a multinational corporate environment
- Demonstrated track record of leading FM transformation — vendor consolidation, IFM implementation, service standardisation and organisational change at scale
- Direct experience managing global or regional IFM partner relationships at a senior level — contract negotiation, performance management and strategic vendor governance
- Strong financial acumen — experienced in holding direct budget authority for significant FM operational spend
- Exposure to regulated environments — life sciences, Good x Practice (GxP), pharmaceutical or chemical manufacturing — strongly preferred
- Exceptional people leader — able to lead a large, diverse and geographically dispersed organisation through transformation
- Data-driven approach to FM performance — familiar with CAFM/IWMS platforms, KPI frameworks and industry benchmarking standards
